market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $115 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$101.79 May 4. Reaching HIGH of $115 in May requires +13% from spot. May 1 high near $106 still leaves ~8% gap to $115. Possible only if Hormuz situation re-escalates significantly or a new supply shock hits. With ceasefire emerging, current price action is downward-biased.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Re-escalation of US-Iran conflict could spike crude rapidly above $110.
